## MeshlineDatabase\.MigrateAsync\(DatabaseOptions, CancellationToken\) Method

Creates or upgrades the SQLite database by applying all pending SDK migrations\.

```csharp
public static System.Threading.Tasks.Task MigrateAsync(Meshline.Storage.DatabaseOptions databaseOptions, System.Threading.CancellationToken cancellationToken=default(System.Threading.CancellationToken));
```

### Remarks
Create the database's parent directory before calling this method\. Applications invoke migrations explicitly; component initialization does not perform schema upgrades automatically\.
